data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the color blue is often associated with spirituality, especially in the context of the Night Journey of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) to the heavens. In this account, described in the Quran (17:1), the Prophet travels through various levels of paradise, which are described using evocative language that includes references to lote tree and gourds, both of which are associated with the color blue. Thus, a name like Neelgoun could be seen as a spiritual manifestation of the beauty and purity that exists above the physical world.
